location: French Quarter, Tremé, Marigny, Bywater & Algiers
heroIntro: Councilmember {councilDisplayName} and {influencerIntro} are supporting District {district}'s hospitality businesses this summer with a special night out to three local favorites across the French Quarter, Tremé, Faubourg-Marigny, Bywater & Algiers!
Vote to decide {councilFirstName} & {influencerFirstName}'s last stop of the night & become a Local Legend by checking in at neighborhood restaurants, bars, music venues and more all summer long!
councilQuote: This isn't just about nightlife; it's about connecting with the community where they are. We're breaking down the walls of City Hall.
influencerQuote: District {district} has some of the most vibrant, unsung spots in the city. I can't wait to show everyone what makes this neighborhood tick.

stops.title: {influencerName}'s Westbank Opener
stops.body: {influencerName} starts us on the far side of the river with a stop that blends music, mood, and a crowd that knows how to show up for local business.
stops.runoffBody: {influencerName} starts us on the far side of the river at Sportsman Bar & Lounge — music, mood, and a crowd that knows how to show up for local business.

stops.title: {councilName}'s Difficult Decision
stops.body: Councilmember {councilName} has a lot of hospitality's finest to choose from for his stop. Les bon temps rouler across District {district}.
stops.runoffBody: Councilmember {councilName} lands at Pepp's Pub — a neighborhood bar that's dog friendly, people tolerant, and full of District {district} character.

stops.title: The District C Vote
stops.body: Help choose where we land last. Your vote decides which {location} venue joins the crawl on July 28 as the community's third stop.
